status: Completed reproducible second-backend placement test and conditional depth-capacity audit; no publication breakthrough established
scope: Published3D-FPIM software backend, unchanged hardware geometry and native instruction vocabulary. Single G4 layer64 experts fixed1280 matrix cores. First3 layers, train32x64 routes only; no holdout or numeric inference.

backend_evidence.adapter: Fixed core-to-tile mapping input inserted before original movement insertion; original partitioner is copied separately, original upstream is unchanged. Hardware common.h hashes identical.
backend_evidence.native_trace_failures: 2 original GP_RANDOM graph cases hit original linearizer input-guard assertion. Analytic GP_RANDOM scores are explicitly not claimed executable; fixed random physical mapping with original semantic affinity executes.
backend_evidence.counter_equality: Every successful checked trace exactly matches independently counted load/store/send/receive and864 MVM depth instructions; zero register spill.
backend_evidence.fixed_addresses: Two different selected routes share60 active matrix cores with identical physical tile/core addresses, checked for both private/aggregate outputs.
backend_evidence.not_established: Native chip runtime, binary/weight programming ABI, numerical accuracy and calibrated cycles/energy. NVSim cannot complete without unpublished example configuration parameters.

placement_result.strong_control: Same native input multicast, activation placement, output policy, capacity and instruction work for all mappings. Marginal multicast affinity baseline uses no joint routing tuples. Corrected-endpoint weighted graph is our greedy/annealing solver, not KaHIP.
placement_result.metric: Train mean send element-length units; no dtype bytes, hardware latency or model speedup claimed.
placement_result.reduction_scope: Existing MULI and ADD instructions implement the same aggregation graph for every layout. Alpha values differ per expert in the toy graph. Precision/scale/order fidelity is unverified, so this is native graph composition and movement only.
placement_result.decision: Traffic gains alone are small, train-only, and exactly expressible as conventional connectivity hypergraph partitioning. Do not claim a new objective or algorithm.
placement_result.independent_audit: 12 exact standard hypergraph evaluations match native multicast objective. Nets include selected common-input consumers, paired gate/up, private activations, and the identical selected-output aggregation policy; fixed IO terminals and exact core capacity are represented.

depth_packing_result.hardware_status: Unverified existing-hardware composition. The source does not establish nonzero absolute-depth group start, independent accumulator clear, programming offsets or numerical QA-ADC scale. No invented reset interpreter is used.
depth_packing_result.conditional_capacity_audit: PASS all unique addresses and all same-layer/phase core collisions. Granite3 geometry admits1152 cores at exact depth-slot capacity floor through purely route-oblivious cross-layer packing; no MoE anti-coactivation required. GU/down core pools disjoint.
depth_packing_result.granite4tiny_geometry: 40-layer expert slots alone require at least5760 cores, exceeding original5376; non-expert weights and quantization can only add requirements.
depth_packing_result.prior: 3D-aCortex already specifies3D kernel packing and explicit layer-select/reset in its own design. IBM US20240086682A1 directly describes MoE expert tiers, including NAND, and sequential selected-expert execution. Neither is evidence for3D-FPIM's missing reset contract.
depth_packing_result.decision: No capacity-fit novelty claim. Only a separately demonstrated latency/movement/throughput tradeoff beyond route-oblivious cross-layer dense packing could justify more work, after the existing instruction contract is verified.
